art_direction: A fictional adult climbing coach demonstrates an easy low wall movement to a group of adult trainee coaches, in an airy training gym. The group observes from a broad continuous mat; there are no children in the scene. The framing is cinematic and professional, emphasizing teaching and teamwork rather than a portrait. Pale climbing volumes against blue and burnt-orange accents, atmospheric directional light; no close-up rope system, dangerous height or text.
